missions.outpost-strike.title: Outpost Strike
missions.outpost-strike.description: Hold the outpost against two minutes of raids, then destroy the enemy factory.
missions.outpost-strike.objectives.holdO: Hold the outpost for two minutes
missions.outpost-strike.messages.briefin: Raiders are on their way from the north-west. Hold the outpost and keep your commander alive.
missions.outpost-strike.messages.strike: The raids have stopped. Take the fight to their factory in the north-west.
missions.outpost-strike.messages.victory: The enemy factory is down. Mission complete.
missions.outpost-strike.messages.defeat: The commander is lost. Mission failed.
